items.title: Do the math: How we took over ChatGPT accounts

extra.evidence: By bypassing ChatGPT's sandbox and content security policy, our research team was able to take over anyone's account simply by sending them a link. In October 2026, we found a way to turn an ordinary public ChatGPT share into attacker-controlled JavaScript running inside the signed-in session of whoever opened it. An attacker could create a malicious conversation, publish it using ChatGPT's normal sharing feature, and send the link to another user. When the victim opened the share, the payload executed as chatgpt.com with access to the victim's authenticated web session. items.title: It wasn't AI that flipped Proton's charge

extra.evidence: Proton's CEO called a request for security testing "loser thinking". Using AI to write code is fine, but for a privacy company, the guardrails around that code are the product. I’ve been paying for Proton for many years, and it’s what I recommend when someone asks how to get off Gmail. This week 404 Media published an investigation into how Proton’s leadership is pushing AI inside the company. The detail that made the rounds came from the security Slack channel: an engineer asked for a few days to pentest new code before shipping it, and CEO Andy Yen answered that it was “bullshit and loser thinking” , then told the team to stop lovingly handcrafting code and use AI more. items.title: 清华姚期智团队新作：代数世界模型，让AI像牛顿一样思考

extra.evidence: 让AI像牛顿一样思考 清华大学 姚期智和袁洋 老师领导的科研团队，搞出了一个重磅项目，叫「代数世界模型」 （Algebraic World Model,AWM） 。 如果让AI只学习牛顿发现万有引力之前的所有知识，它能自己把万有引力给推导出来吗？ 尴尬的是，训练数据容易被污染，很难复原出这样的情景：打造一个完全陌生的世界，让AI从0开始观察和实验。 但如今，代数世界模型给出了一种新解法。让AI从观察和实验出发，进一步理解世界这件事，变得没那么遥远了。 有个叫ARC-AGI-3的游戏集，现在是各大前沿模型秀肌肉的地方。这游戏的特点就是，啥也不告诉你，没有规则，没有目标。 像GPT Astra这种顶流选手，配合Provider Adapter框架，在这里面能拿到 99.9% 的高分。 Astra生成的这些规则，就是第谷的笔记本，不是开普勒的定律。它只描述了现象，没抓住这个迷你游戏世界运行的本质。 研究人员把其中一个叫 sc25 的游戏，稍微改了改，初始步数设置成了一个根本不可能通关的数字。 结果，Astra试了8轮，有点沮丧，然后断言：18步肯定不行， 我估计至少要22步才能赢。 这还不是个例。在12次类似的测试里，顶级的GPT-6 Astra和Claude Opus 5.5加起来，只有5次判断出「不可能」，其中4次给出的最低步数还是错的。 但如果在现实世界里，让一个AI智能体去执行任务，它告诉你「这事儿没戏」，还给个错误的原因，那后果可能就严重了。 我们真正需要的，是AI在任务不可能时，能清楚地告诉我们「为什么不可能」，并且给出准确的判断，比如「只要条件再增加一点点，就可能了」。 这时候，就得靠代数的力量了。也就是前面提到的，清华团队搞的那个 代数世界模型 （AWM） 。 把游戏里的所有对象、关系和规则，抽象成一个「代数世界」。然后，利用大模型现在已经超强的数学能力，去理解…

items.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
items.summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have made substantial progress in robotic manipulation, but their generalization remains constrained by the diversity and coverage of action-labeled robot demonstrations. Human videos provide much broader behavioral and environmental experience, while learning from them faces a fundamental trade-off between scalable data and explicit action grounding. We introduce ThinkWorld, a VLA learning framework that grounds action reasoning in world dynamics and strengthens it through reinforcement learning with world imagination. ThinkWorld represents each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics (CoD), a sequence of discrete motion tokens that captures the intermediate dynamics connecting the current world to a future state and serves as a common action representation across embodiments. We first initialize CoD with action-labeled demonstrations, then predict the future induced by each CoD and reinforce those whose predictions better match the observed outcome. This enables videos without action annotations to provide direct supervision from observed state transitions, allowing human and robot experience to refine the same reasoning space. Experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate effective human-to-robot transfer and strong generalization to unseen tasks and environments.
items.title_zh: ThinkWorld：世界想象强化动态推理
items.summary_zh: 针对视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操作中泛化能力受限的问题，提出ThinkWorld框架。该方法将动作推理建立在世界动力学上，并通过强化学习进行强化。实验表明，该方法实现了有效的人机迁移，并能泛化到未见过的任务和环境。

items.title: Proving and Improving the Platonic Representation Hypothesis with JEPAs
items.summary: Whether models trained on different modalities converge to the same representation of the world is central to AI. The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) conjectures that they do as they scale, but without a proof it offers neither a guarantee nor a recipe. We turn the hypothesis into a theorem. First, we prove a Platonic Representation Theorem: Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) trained separately on any number of modalities learn the same representation up to one rotation whenever their positive pairs are two observations of one scene--good views--and their misalignment is bounded otherwise. Second, we show that next-token prediction is a JEPA with bad views, parts of a single document, which explains why language models align with vision only through scale. Third, we validate the theory from 145k captions to the texts of 940M web images, and uncover a scaling law of alignment that predicts unseen runs within seed noise. Good views need 42 times fewer training samples than next-token prediction on the same corpus to reach the same alignment, and a 109M-parameter text JEPA aligns with DINOv2 and CLIP's image encoders better than every language model we evaluated, up to 72B parameters, and than CLIP's text encoder: next-token prediction is a remarkably inefficient route to platonic representations. As a showcase, one rotation turns separately trained encoders into an image captioner (CIDEr .838 on COCO). Even that rotation needs no pair: on the latest pair…

items.title: DeFT-RAG: Incrementally Decomposing Multi-Hop Questions into Self-Contained Sub-Questions with Reusable Answers
items.summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) lets a large language model (LLM) answer questions by retrieving relevant passages from a large corpus. However, RAG struggles with multi-hop questions, which require chaining facts spread across several documents through intermediate entities that the question never mentions. Graph-based RAG methods retrieve once from the entities a question names and so rarely recover the full evidence chain. Iterative RAG methods recover it step by step, but their accuracy is limited by the many tasks they ask the LLM to perform, such as planning the sub-questions, deciding their dependencies, rewriting them as answers arrive, and keeping track of what is known. We propose DeFT-RAG, a RAG framework built on three components. First, DeFT-RAG generates one self-contained sub-question at a time from the original question and the sub-questions answered so far with their answers (QA pairs). Each sub-question names every entity it asks about, which removes the need to plan, track dependencies or rewrite, and lets the LLM focus on a single fine-grained task at a time. Second, DeFT-RAG moves the remaining LLM work outside the LLM: rule-based updates to a QA table that keeps track of what is known, and yes/no decisions made by a fine-tuned lightweight decision model. Third, DeFT-RAG caches the QA pairs and reuses an answer when a later question asks a sub-question with the same meaning. On MuSiQue, 2WikiMultiHopQA and HotpotQA, DeFT-RAG achieves the best accura…
items.summary_zh: 针对检索增强生成在处理多跳问题时的困难，提出DeFT-RAG框架。该方法通过生成自包含的子问题并缓存答案，简化了LLM的任务。实验表明，该方法在多个数据集上取得了最佳准确率。

items.title: What Effort Level Should I Choose? On the Economics of Reasoning Effort in LLM Agents
items.summary: Generative models increasingly expose a reasoning effort setting that lets users scale inference-time compute, trading higher cost for potentially improved performance. Users must choose an effort level before knowing whether extra reasoning will help, and even a successful run does not reveal whether the effort purchased was necessary. Reasoning effort is therefore a credence good: buyers observe the outcome but cannot assess the marginal value of the computation they paid for. In this work, we measure the counterfactual effect of effort levels on both proprietary and open-weight models on four benchmarks, spanning single-call reasoning and long-horizon agentic tasks. Effort, it turns out, does not consistently preserve tasks that lower effort solves, can overspend, and can change trajectory behavior. First, we find that although higher effort can raise accuracy in aggregate, it frequently fails on tasks that lower effort solved. Second, on the subset of easy tasks that every effort level solves, higher effort is generally more costly, with the highest effort level costing up to 42x as much as the lowest. Lastly, effort changes not only how many tokens are used, but also how agents solve tasks: at higher effort, agents verify their own work more heavily and more often search for solutions than work through problems directly, both of which lengthen trajectories without necessarily altering the outcome. These findings show that naively choosing the highest level is not only c…
items.title_zh: LLM智能体推理努力的经济性研究
items.summary_zh: 针对LLM智能体推理努力设置的经济性问题，分析了不同努力水平对性能的影响。研究发现，更高的努力并不总能提升性能，且容易在低努力水平已解决的任务上失败。此外，高努力水平会改变智能体的任务解决轨迹。

items.title: Predicting What Answer Engines Cite: Open Decision Models, Rerankers and a Distilled 4B Student on Ten Engines under Controlled Retrieval
items.summary: Generative engine optimization needs a scorer that ranks candidate pages by the share of an answer they will receive as citations. We measure pretrained rerankers, a hosted typed decision model (Jev), eight open decision models and distilled students on GEO-Bench queries answered by ten engines that receive the same candidate sources in their prompt. Where several engines answer the same query, they agree with one another at a within-group Spearman correlation of 0.704. Jev and two open 27B decision models, used without training, are the strongest scorers at 0.575 to 0.578. A Qwen3-Reranker-4B fine-tuned with low-rank adapters on teacher labels for other GEO-Bench queries, released as GEO Citation Ranker 4B, reaches 0.542 to 0.549 across three seeds, and its differences with the 27B models and with Jev are not distinguishable from zero on 229 queries. Most of the remaining distance between the student and Jev disappears when Jev scores one passage at a time, as the student does. Students trained on teacher labels and on observed engine citations reach the same level, and labels from Jev alone match the two-teacher target at 0.6B. We release the model, the benchmark, the predictions of every reported scorer and the code.
items.title_zh: 预测答案引擎引用：开放决策模型与蒸馏模型
items.summary_zh: 针对生成式引擎优化中评分器的需求，评估了多种模型在GEO-Bench查询上的表现。研究发现，开放决策模型和蒸馏模型在评分上表现接近，且当评分模型逐段评分时，学生模型与教师模型的差距缩小。研究发布了模型、基准和代码。
